During the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] at the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Bacta Squad]], a unit of [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page's]] [[Katarn Commandos]], battled [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]] near [[Shimrra's Citadel]]. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Page reached the citadel with the rest of his [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], '''one member''' of the team, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], approached him and asked for backup. Page sent ten commandos.
